errors.description: sample_packet_q is a multi-bit value produced in sensor_clk and sampled directly in fabric_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
sample_pulse_q is a one-cycle sensor_clk pulse consumed directly in fabric_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
sample_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample fabric_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in fabric_event_o.
format_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector format_q before decoding in fabric_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
sensor_rst_n is used as data inside fabric_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
cfg_snapshot_q combines sensor_clk payload state with fabric_clk status state in cfg_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
